title: Sagaleewwan Waaqeffamanii Nabiyyii Cinaa
intro: Biyya fagoo tokko keessatti ergamaan kabajamaan tokko humnoota bara sanaa bulchaa turan irraa diddaa hamaa isa mudate. Ta’us geengoon xiqqaan lubbuuwwan of kennanii hojjetan gabricha Rabbii kana cinaa dhaabbatanii waamicha waaqaa deebisuuf fedhii guddaa qaban turan. Amantiin isaanii kan hin sochoone saba humna guddaa qabu tokko addaan qoodee dhumarratti humnoota kufrii irratti injifata.
clues: Garee xiqqaa of kenne, amantii fi kaayyoodhaan tokko taane.
Ergamaa kabajamaa aangawoota humna guddaa qaban lafa isaaniitiin fudhatama dhabe cinaa dhaabanne.
Ergamaan kun yeroo gaafatu, ‘Daandii Rabbii irratti deeggartoonni kiyya eenyu?’. jennee osoo hin shakkiin deebisne.
Ergamaa kana garaa keenyatti tasgabbii akka fiduuf samii irraa ayyaana akka barbaadu gaafanne.
Namoota bara sanii keessaa kaan karaa ergaa keenya amane kaan immoo mata jabeessan dide, Rabbiin garuu amantoota jabeesse.
Nuti Hawwariyyun — duuka bu’oota Isaa of kennanii, deeggarsa Rabbiitiin injifataman.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Deeggartoota ergama raajii tokkootti amanamummaa waadaa galuu
Holqa cufame keessaa hirriba keessatti kunuunfamuu
Ajaja raajiitiin galaana addaan bahuu dhugaa ba'uu
trial.answer: Deeggartoota ergama raajii tokkootti amanamummaa waadaa galuu

location.label: Qaama Ijoo
options: Minjaala nyaata samii samii irraa babal'ate
Doonii waaqni ijaaramtee fiixee gaara tokkorra boqotte
Gaala dubaraa dhagaa jabaa keessaa baate
location.answer: Minjaala nyaata samii samii irraa babal'ate

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Warra ergaa sana didan irratti ol’aantummaa akka qabaatan taasifamaniiru
Bulchaa cunqursaa fi waraanni isaa bishaaniin liqimfamuu isaa arge
Warqee fi qabeenya hin himamne kuufatee garuu of tuulummaadhaan barbadaa'e
outcome.answer: Warra ergaa sana didan irratti ol’aantummaa akka qabaatan taasifamaniiru

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
